fragments.text: אֶת חִיל יוֹם פְּקֻדָּה. בְּאֵימָיו כָּל לְחֻם לְשָׁקְדָה. גָּשִׁים בּוֹ בֶּרֶךְ לִקּוֹדָה. דֵּעָם לְיַשֵּׁר כְּעַל מוֹקְדָה: הַיּוֹצֵר יַחַד כֶּסֶל נִשְׁפָּט. וְשׁוֹעַ וָדַל בְּפִלּוּס יִשְׁפָּט. זֵכֶר לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט. חִין עֶרְכּוֹ יִזָּכֵר בַּמִּשְׁפָּט: טֶרֶם כָּל מִפְעַל חָצַב. יָזַם בְּמַחֲשֶׁבֶת צוּר חֻצַּב. כְּאָחוֹר וָקֶדֶם כְּתָוֶךְ

נֶחֱצַב. לְיָהֵב עָלָיו כָּל הַמַּחֲצָב: מְנָתוֹ כְּהַיּוֹם כֹחַ דֻּשָּׁנָה. נֵצֶר לְהַחֲנִיט לְתִשְׁעִים שָׁנָה. סִיְמָה אוֹת הֱיוֹת לְשׁוֹשַׁנָּה. עֲבוֹר לְפָנָיו כְּזֶה רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה: פִּלְצוּ פְרָחֶיהָ

כְּזֶה יוֹם. צְנָחָם פְּנֵי כֵס אָיוֹם. קוֹל דִּכּוּכָם יַרְחִישׁוּ כְּהַיּוֹם. רוֹגְשִׁים לְהָרִיעַ לִמְצוֹא פִדְיוֹם: שְׁעוּנִים עָלֶיהָ בָּהּ לְהִפָּקְדָה. שׁוֹאֲגִים בְּלַהַק דְּלָתוֹת לְשָׁקְדָה.
תְּמוּכִים בְּדֶשֶׁן שֶׂה עֲקֵדָה. תֶּשֶׁר אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ נִפְקָדָה:

The fearful day of reckoning has arrived. All flesh is full of dread of reprimand. They approach to bend the knee before Him, to purify their thoughts as in the flame of the altar. He who has formed the heart of all of them together, judges so that rich and poor alike are judged according to the scales. He remembers him who said: ‘Will He not do justice?’ His valued prayer will be recalled in judgment. Before He formed any creature, he had planned that rock from which we were hewn (Abraham). Central between past and future

was he hewn, on him the whole structure is founded. His allotted wife was on this day granted vigour to bring forth a shoot at ninety years. She was set as an example for the roselike nation to appear before God at this beginning of the year. Her children tremble on this day while they stand before the awe-inspiring throne. They let their prayers be heard this day. They blow with a loud blast to find salvation. On her (Sarah) do they rely, to be considered for her sake, they cry out in assembly, knock at the gates,
depend on the ashes of the sheep at the sacrifice of Isaac, the glorious gift with which she had been considered.

identity_policy: Correct canonical spelling of the same draft poem identity and structural contexts; old URNs remain aliases. No edition difference or placement creates a new canonical work. Frozen earlier readings and actual review outputs retain their original spelling.
